subject.title: fix(native): keep images and voice notes visible in chat and exports

question: Should this protected native-client fix land after a final-head refresh and redacted real-runtime evidence, or does the current native-suite evidence satisfy the maintainer’s proof standard?
rationale: The patch has no supported line-level correctness defect, but the protected label and absence of an inspectable real-runtime artifact leave a proof-standard choice that automation should not make.

options.title: Request native runtime proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or device recording, terminal transcript, or runtime log showing canonical image and audio entries visible in chat and retained in a Markdown export, then refresh the branch before merge.

options.title: Accept current native-suite proof
options.body: Treat the reported baseline reproduction, focused tests, full native-suite run, and hosted native CI as sufficient for this narrowly scoped internal rendering repair.

recommendation.title: Request native runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted simulator or device recording, terminal transcript, or runtime log showing canonical image and audio entries visible in chat and retained in a Markdown export, then refresh the branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history makes this person the only concrete routing candidate for the modified native chat surface.
